A narration of Haakim states that all Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) possessed at the time was a dish for washing clothes, a plate and a jug.

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) fell ill, Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) visited him. When he saw Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) weeping, Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) asked, "What makes you cry, dear brother? Did you not spend time in the company of Rasulullaah ﷺ?" Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) then continues to enumerate various accomplishments of Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) (to give him encouragement). Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) replied, "I am not crying for any one of two things. I am not crying for greed of this world nor for dislike of the Aakhirah. I am crying because Rasulullaah ﷺ gave me explicit instructions that I have transgressed." "What did he instruct you with?" asked Hadhrat Sa'd (RA). Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) said, "The instructions of Rasulullaah ﷺ were that only the provisions of a traveller is sufficient for us. I think that I have certainly transgressed the instruction. As for you, O Sa'd. My advice is that you fear Allaah when you pass judgement, when you distribute and when you make any intentions." A narrator called Thaabit says that he received the news that the estate that Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) left amounted to only twenty odd Dirhams and a little money for expenses.[^2]
Why Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) was Concerned at the Time of Death

Hadhrat Aamir bin Abdullaah narrates that when Hadhrat Salmaan "al Khayr"[^3] (RA) was on his deathbed, the people noticed that he was somewhat uneasy. They asked "O Abu Abdullaah! What makes you so restless when you were amongst the earliest Muslims and when you accompanied Rasulullaah ﷺ in great battles and coveted conquests?" Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) replied, "What concerns me is that when he was parting from us, my beloved friend ﷺ explicitly instructed that the mere provisions of a traveller should suffice for us. This is what makes me so uneasy." When all the possessions were evaluated, it amounted to only fifteen Dirhams.[^4]
